(2000A) TERMINATIONOFLEASEAGREEMENT THISTERMINATIONOFLEASEAGREEMENT,madeasofJune15,2006 public benefit corporation of the State of New York, duly organized and existing under the laws of the State of New York (the “Agency"), having its principal office at 110 William Street, New York, New York 10038, and YOUNG ADULT INSTITUTE, INC., a not-for-profit corporation organized and existing under the laws of the State of New York (the “Participant"), having its principal office at 460 West 34"h Street, New York, New York 10001 (capitalized terms used but not defined herein shall have the respective meanings assigned to such terms in the Lease Agreement and the Indenture referred to below), WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,on August 17, 2000, the Agency issued its Civic Facility Revenue Bonds (Special Needs Facilities Pooled Program), Series 2000A-1 (the“2000A Bonds") for the purpose of, among others, financing or refinancing the costs of the acquisition, construction, equipping and furnishing of seven civic facilities (collectively, the “Facilities") (as more particularly describing in Exhibit A attached hereto and made a part hereof) consisting of (i) a residential facility consisting of three condominium units for eight individuals with developmental disabilities, located at 29-43 Tiffany Place, Units 1A, 1B and 1C, Brooklyn, New York; (i) a residential facility for eight individuals with development disabilities, located at 2422 Bragg Street, Brooklyn, New York; (ii) a residential facility for eight individuals with developmental disabilities, located at 1015 Avenue Z, Brooklyn, New York; (iv) a residential facility for eight individuals with developmental disabilities,located at 2140 Glebe Avenue, Bronx, New York; (v) a day habilitation facility for forty-five individuals with developmental disabilities, located on the entire second floor of 211-11 Northern Blvd., Queens, New York; (vi) a day habilitation facility for thirty-two individualswith developmental disabilities,located on the entire store front of 3340-42Nostrand Avenue,Brooklyn,NewYork;and(vii)a day habilitation facility for fifty individuals with developmental disabilities, located on the entire 9h floor of 460West 34"Street,NewYork,NewYork,all for the provision of services to people WHEREAS, the Participant leased or subleased, as applicable, the Facilities to the Agency pursuant to a Company Lease Agreement, dated as of June 1, 200o, between the Participant and the Agency (the “Company Lease"), which was recorded on or about (i) March 30, 2001, in the Office of the Register of The City of New York, Bronx County, New York (the “Bronx Register's Office") in Reel 1854 and Page 818, (ii) October 30, 2000, in the Office of the Register of The City of New York, Queens County, New York (the “Queens Register's Office") in Reel 5709 and Page 2226, and (i) September 26, 2000, in the Office of the Register of The City of New York, Kings County, New York (the “Kings County Register's Office") in Reel 4972 and Page 878; and 498631.3029409TERM

WHEREAS, the Agency and the Participant entered into a Lease Agreement, dated as of June 1, 200o, between the Agency and the Participant (the “Lease Agreement"), which was recorded in (i) the Bronx Register's Office on or about March 30, 2001, in Reel 1854 and Page 2128, and (iii) in the Kings Register's Office on or about September 26, 2000, in Reel 4972 and Page 665, whereby the Agency subleased or subsubleased, as applicable,the Facilities to the Participant; and WHEREAS, the Participant has exercised its option pursuant to Section 8.1(a) of the Lease Agreement to make advance rental payments and have the outstanding Bonds allocable totheParticipant(the“Defeased Bonds")defeased in wholeonthedatehereofpursuant to Section10.01of theIndenture of Trust,dated as of June1,2000(the“Indenture"),between the Agency and The Bank of New York (successor to United States Trust Company of New York), as trustee, which was recorded (i) in the Bronx Register's Office on or about March 30, 2001, in Reel1854 and Page 957,(i) in the Queens Register's Office on or about October 30,2000, in Reel 5709 and Page 2248, and (i) in the Kings Register's Office on or about September 26, 2000, in Reel 4972 and Page 508; and WHEREAS, after providing for the defeasance of the Defeased Bonds in accordance with the Indenture and for the payment of all other amounts due by the Participant under the Lease Agreement and the Indenture and the other Security Documents to which the Participant is a party, the Participant desires to terminate the Lease Agreement pursuant to Section 8.4 of the Lease Agreement; and WHEREAS, the Agency and the Participant desire to terminate the Lease Agreement in accordancewith this Agreement; and WHEREAS, all necessary consents, opinions and notices for the execution of this Agreement have been either obtained or waived; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises and the respective representations and agreements hereinafter contained, the parties hereto agree as follows: Section 1.1 Terminationof theLeaseAgreement.  The Agency and the Participant hereby agree that the Lease Agreement is terminated and cancelled as of the date hereof, subject to the survival of the obligations of the Participant under Sections 4.3 (until such and 9.17 of the Lease Agreement and any other provisions of the Lease Agreement which provisions do not run with the land. Section 2. No Assignment of Lease Agreement. The parties hereby represent that their respective rights under the Lease Agreement have not been assigned, except as provided in the Indenture. 2 498631.3 029409 TERM

Section 3. Counterparts. This Agreement may be simultaneously executed in several counterparts,each of which shall be an original and all of which shall constitute but one and the same instrument. Section 4. Miscellaneous. This Agreement shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of the State of NewYork. (b) )The terms of this Agreement are and shall be binding upon and inure to benefit of the Participant and the Agency and their respective successors and assigns. (c) The Participant and the Agency agree that this Agreement shall be recorded by the Participant in the appropriate Offices of the Register of The City of New York. IN WITNESSWHEREOF,the parties heretohave caused thisAgreement to be executed in their names and on their behalf by their duly authorized representatives, all as of the date first above written.
